Carey Lexington  Washn Sept 12th 1864
Fanny Forbid for Kent Your proposed tablet
should be made as Early as possible
while Hemps pelton is occupied by Nabob
trance Harvard walrus Jacob have additions arrived 


Capt Smith St Louis  Washn Sept 12th 1864
Fanny forbid Moon zebra Jupiters orders are that
Maynard will opr rate against Price & Co
as he may deem best and that you 
will give him all the assistance in your
power zodiac Lavender must decide for himself in
regard tooth spartans torch postpone Agnew webster Italy


Washn Sept 12th 1864
Gertrude Hoffman for Billy Yacht The Santiago one of
our Blockading squadron plated a few days ago the 
blockade runner CD Vance from Haddock yards On 
board of the Vance was found an Italian named 
Antonzini who was brought in to Hampton weakness yesterday
on the Santiago He was found double ironed Had
been condemned to death by the Violet Sharper for
treason and was being deported to Bermuda his punishment
having been commuted This morning Mr Fox brought me
a letter from Antonzini offering to give Spencer for
the destruction of Pilot on the Clyde Warner stick
I have requested Mr Fox to have him sent
direct to you from Bunyan yawl Comb chilly day
